title: PID Gains Store and Update
text: Store and update tuned PID gains tuned using Closed-Loop PID Autotuner, 4 inputs, 1 output, {Controller type} sets PID controller type P; {Use for gain scheduling} enables block for gain scheduling, {Save breakpoints in gain array} sets the save breakpoints along with PID gains, {Breakpoints} sets the gain scheduling breakpoints, {Number of breakpoints}, {Use external signal} sets the breakpoints from input port, {Gain index tolerance}, {Method of storing gains}, {P Gain Parameter Name} sets the proportional gain data, {P Gain initial conditions} sets the proportional gain initial value, {I Gain Parameter Name} sets the integral gain data, {I Gain initial conditions} sets the integral gain initial value, {D Gain Parameter Name} sets the derivative gain data, {D Gain initial conditions} sets the derivative gain initial value, {N Gain Parameter Name} sets the filter gain data, {N Gain initial conditions} sets the filter gain initial value, {Method to trigger gain update} sets the update trigger method Detect change in PID, {Number of samples to delay update}, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} and {Data Type} sets the floating point precision. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Controller type
params.values: PID controller type P (default) | I | PI | PD | PDN | PID | PIDN

params.name: Use for gain scheduling
params.values: Enable block for gain scheduling on (default) | off

params.name: Save breakpoints in gain array
params.values: Save breakpoints along with PID gains off (default) | on

params.name: Breakpoints
params.values: Gain scheduling breakpoints [1 2 3] (default) | vector

params.name: Number of breakpoints
params.values: Number of breakpoints 3 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Use external signal
params.values: Specify breakpoints from input port off (default) | on

params.name: Gain index tolerance
params.values: Gain index tolerance 1e-3 (default) | nonegative scalar

params.name: Method of storing gains
params.values: Method of storing gains Data store memory (default) | Goto/from | Output from block

params.name: P Gain Parameter Name
params.values: Proportional gain data name PGain (default) | string

params.name: P Gain initial conditions
params.values: Proportional gain initial value 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: I Gain Parameter Name
params.values: Integral gain data name IGain (default) | string

params.name: I Gain initial conditions
params.values: Integral gain initial value 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: D Gain Parameter Name
params.values: Derivative gain data name DGain (default) | string

params.name: D Gain initial conditions
params.values: Derivative gain initial value 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: N Gain Parameter Name
params.values: Filter gain data name NGain (default) | string

params.name: N Gain initial conditions
params.values: Filter gain initial value 100 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Method to trigger gain update
params.values: Update trigger method Detect change in PID gains (default) | External trigger

params.name: Number of samples to delay update
params.values: Number of samples to delay update 1 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: Sample time -1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Data Type
params.values: Floating point precision Double (default) | Single
